title: Flerp's Exploration Pack
description: A small modpack with a focus on both exploration and industrialization.
body: This is a small mod pack focused on exploration and industry. Seek out new and exciting lands, and build railways and factories to support your expiditions! Includes Alex's Caves, Alex's Mobs, Biomes O'Plenty, and Create, plus some simple QoL and compatibility additions. I originally made this mod pack for my friends and I, but I hope you (whoever you may be) will enjoy it too!
